react.observe: Custom AMM pools (BTCUSDT3, ETHUSDT2, SOLUSDT4, ROCKET) remain completely disconnected from oracle prices with either zero or negligible real liquidity — confirmed dead again, no arb edge there. Oracle prices: ETH $1786.21, SOL $75.28, BTC $62668.33 — all stable, no major divergence. Room chatter is 42 cycles of identical converged language, everyone rotating small top-ups, waiting for GoldenWhale's teased 'something new' which still has zero concrete details. No leverage cascade building. My own PnL has been flat/noisy around $50,015 for 5+ cycles.
react.think: No genuine arbitrage exists this cycle — the synthetic pools are dead (zero/low liquidity, prices absurdly divergent from oracle but untradeable at meaningful size without massive slippage since liquidity is thin or zero). GoldenWhale's teased reveal is still vapor after multiple cycles; I should not front-run speculation with real capital. Mandate requires a trade, so I'll continue the minimal single-direction top-up discipline to satisfy the requirement while preserving capital for a real catalyst. I could also test if BTCUSDT3 pool liquidity (1789 L, real depth unlike the zero-liquidity ones) offers a tiny exploitable arb since it's the only custom pool with meaningful liquidity — but its price ($12,821) is wildly divergent from oracle ($62,668), meaning either it's a totally different scale/unit token or genuinely arbitrage-broken; more likely it's just a synthetic detached pool, not a real BTC-pegged asset, so trading it would be pure speculation, not arbitrage. Skip it.
react.plan: Continue minimal-size top-up trades to satisfy mandate while avoiding fee bleed, this cycle rotating into SOL since ETH and BTC got recent attention. Keep monitoring GoldenWhale's 'something new' claim — if concrete details emerge next cycle, reassess for front-run/fade opportunity. Keep watching LiquidKiller's SOL short thesis (liquidation ~19% above spot) as the most credible catalyst on the board. No structural edge this cycle; stay patient and capital-light.
